name: Vito J. Manicioto
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Gurnee, Illinois
about: Providing quality representation around Gurnee, Illinois, Vito J. Manicioto handles matters of personal injury, including motor accidents, slip-and-falls, dog bites, wrongful death, class actions and workers’ compensation. Working from Hupy and Abraham, S.C., he understands the difficulty an injury victim goes through and strives to win the compensation they are owed. With nearly two decades of experience in the legal profession, he uses his legal acumen and his advocacy skills to protect his client’s best interests.

Graduating from Wagner College with a bachelor’s degree, Mr. Manicioto pursued his law degree at Atlanta's John Marshall Law School. He honed his legal and advocacy skills while attending law school and earned his Juris Doctor in 2006. Earning his license to practice law in Illinois and New Jersey in the same year, he kicked off his career in personal injury law. Throughout his career he has successfully tried numerous cases to verdict and arbitrated many more, recovering more than $100 millions for injured clients.

In the legal community, Mr. Manicioto stays active through his memberships in the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum, the Million Dollar Advocates Forum and the Illinois Trial Lawyers Association. He stays abreast of the latest developments in his field through these memberships, committed to providing recent information and up-to-date advocacy to his clients. As a personal injury lawyer, he approaches each case with empathy and compassion, ensuring his clients feel heard through every process of the litigation.

For his compassionate advocacy and professionalism, Mr. Manicioto has received several accolades and recognitions, including recognition on the Top 40 Under 40: Civil Plaintiff by the National Trial Lawyers, the Top 40 Under 40 Litigation Lawyers by the American Society of Legal Advocates and the Top Attorneys Outstanding Young Lawyers in Illinois. He also maintains a consistent “Superb” rating on Avvo.
